title: Rokudo's Bad Girls
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tousuke Rokudou, a weak first-year at a school full of delinquents, is bullied constantly. A scroll from his late grandfather, meant to ward off demons, instead makes 'bad girls' fall in love with him on sight. He gathers a circle of tough delinquent girls, helps many of them reform, and slowly earns respect by refusing to run from fights.
life_message: Courage, loyalty and kindness can win respect and help people change, even in a rough world.

folkways.japan: Banchou and sukeban delinquent hierarchies and the inherited onmyoji-style scroll draw on Japanese school-gang and folk-religious traditions, noted as context.

delivery.evidence: ANN preview reviewers (anime) criticize the premise but call nothing preachy; reform shown through episodes (Wikipedia).
delivery.note: Reform and loyalty are shown through each girl's arc rather than stated.

winners_losers: Rokudou and the reformed girls win a calmer school life; bullies who change are welcomed, while unreformed gangs and loan sharks lose.
